description:
FARAD SPACE is the space branch of FARAD Robotics, one of Azerbaijan's first student robotics and engineering teams, founded in Baku in 2020. Our members study mechatronics, robotics, software and data science, and we build space and aviation systems, CubeSats, rockets, drones, underwater robots (AUVs) and AI tools.

For NASA Space Apps 2026 (Planet X and SPHEREx) we built SkyLapse, a free public web tool that joins 16 years of NASA WISE/NEOWISE and SPHEREx infrared images into one movie, so anyone can watch nearby stars and brown dwarfs move and see their SPHEREx spectra. Live tool: skylapse.vercel.app
